chapter: Latin bands, Wilbur DeParis and Goodman
title: A year in Boston with Vic Dickenson at Mahogany Hall
summary: After Prado he spent about a year in Boston with Vic Dickenson, where his son was born.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Uh-huh. But-- so this is all before you went to Boston. Did you go to Boston with Vic Dickenson?
Well I went to Boston, yes, that was before. No, that was 1952.
Cause that was after Perez Prado, then I went to Boston with Vic Dickenson at the Mahogany Hall.
And you were there for quite a while.
Oh, for at least a year. And my son was born during that time there, Boston.
Uh-huh. You really were living in Boston?
